title: SEPTEMBER 11, 2001: THE DAY THE WORLD STOOD STILL

scenes.name: THE OPENING
scenes.camera: a slow push across the Hudson toward Lower Manhattan on a clear morning

scenes.name: THE ATTACKS
scenes.camera: the skyline as architectural silhouettes; a clock and a timeline mark 8:46 and 9:03

scenes.name: THE DISASTER SPREADS
scenes.camera: a map of the eastern United States: New York, Washington, Shanksville

scenes.name: THE AFTERMATH
scenes.camera: the skyline under a cloud of smoke; then responders and people in the dust

scenes.name: THE FINAL MESSAGE
scenes.camera: the memorial pools; twin beams of light; the words; the channel's mark

lines.text: At 8:46 a.m., an ordinary morning changed forever.
lines.tts: At eight forty-six AM an ordinary morning changed forever.

lines.text: Two hijacked passenger planes struck the towers of the World Trade Center.
lines.tts: Two hijacked passenger planes struck the towers of the World Trade Center.

lines.text: Another hit the Pentagon. A fourth crashed in Pennsylvania, after passengers and crew fought back.
lines.tts: Another hit the Pentagon. A fourth crashed in Pennsylvania, after passengers and crew fought back.

lines.text: Both towers fell. Nearly 3,000 people were killed, leaving families and communities devastated.
lines.tts: Both towers fell. Nearly three thousand people were killed, leaving families and communities devastated.

lines.text: And the world would never be the same.
lines.tts: And the world would never be the same.
